newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas prices lifted by western demand.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas prices lifted by western demand.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices edged higher Monday amid a strong northern California demand and tighter supplies in Alberta, traders said.
Gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was quoted at C$1.51-1.52 per gigajoule, up an average of three cents from Friday and up about five cents from weekend values at C$1.45-1.46, traders said.
August AECO also rose slightly to about C$1.51, while September was quoted around C$1.49.
